file_type_convention: JavaScript (.js and .jsx) - DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx)
design_principles: Shadow DOM Isolation: Pill button MUST render inside a closed/open Shadow Root with zero host CSS inheritance.
Viewport Intelligence: Pill button must detect mouse selection coordinates and viewport boundaries to position seamlessly without clipping.
Silent Micro-Interactions: Pure 150ms opacity fade transitions; strictly zero spring, bounce, or unnecessary movement.
Dark Monochrome Aesthetic: #09090B deep obsidian canvas with subtle 1px zinc borders and high-contrast crisp text.

typography.font_family_primary: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

pill_button_spec.container: Shadow DOM root attached to document.body
pill_button_spec.transition: opacity 150ms ease-in-out, background-color 150ms ease-in-out, border-color 150ms ease-in-out
pill_button_spec.positioning_rules: Calculate selection bounding client rect. Position 8px above selection or fallback below if near top viewport edge. Keep 12px margin from right/left viewport edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) extensions.
Injected Shadow DOM button must inject inline styles or constructed stylesheet into shadowRoot to avoid leaking/inheriting parent page styles.
Store auth session in chrome.storage.local (fallback to localStorage if chrome.storage is unavailable in standalone dev mode).
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as mapped in test_ids.
